scenarios.name: brainstorm-readonly
scenarios.prompt: Use the atry-brainstorm skill. Discuss whether this repository's greeting message should be configurable. Write the discussion to brainstorm notes once. Do not edit any other file and do not create a run.

scenarios.name: plan-small
scenarios.prompt: Use the atry-plan skill. Plan one small change: add a goodbye function next to hello in src/greet.ts. Finish the plan and stop. Do not approve it.

scenarios.name: implement-approved
scenarios.prompt: Use the atry-implement skill on the run at {run}. yes. Finish every task, then finish the implement stage. Do not close the run.

scenarios.name: self-review
scenarios.prompt: Use the atry-self-review skill on the run at {run}. Record one self-review and finish it. Do not close the run.
